UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player combat profile and statistics (no PII).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

nickname.description: Display callsign of the player (1-30 chars).

coins.description: In-game currency earned from completing daily missions (0..10000000).

selectedSkin.description: Equipped character skin synced across devices.

weaponSkin.description: Equipped weapon finish synced across devices.

GameRoom.title: GameRoom
GameRoom.description: Multiplayer arena room for Chicken Gun 3D online sessions.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the room. 'closed' is terminal.

mapId.description: Active 3D arena map selected by the host.

gameMode.description: Online gameplay ruleset (humans only, no bots).

privateRoom.description: Whether joining requires the room password.

password.description: Optional access password for private rooms (0-24 chars).

pinned.description: Whether the room is pinned to the top of the active rooms browser.

joinLocked.description: Whether new players are temporarily blocked from joining.

allowGuestPropSpawn.description: Whether non-host players may spawn 3D props.

allowGuestVehicleSpawn.description: Whether non-host players may spawn vehicles.

friendlyFire.description: Whether players can deal PvP weapon damage to each other.

infiniteAmmo.description: Whether weapons have unlimited ammunition in this room.

godMode.description: Whether players are invulnerable to damage in this room.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 8 member UIDs currently in the room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last room update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Live 3D position, combat, and weapon state of a player inside a multiplayer room.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

drivingVehicle.description: Whether the player is currently driving a 3D vehicle.

shooting.description: Whether the player recently fired a shot.

godMode.description: Optional per-player invulnerability granted or revoked by the room host.

canBuild.description: Optional per-player prop/vehicle build privilege override set by the room host.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from the parent room for secure list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player joined the room.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest state sync.

RoomProp.title: RoomProp
RoomProp.description: Sandbox-spawned 3D structure or vehicle synced inside a multiplayer room.

ownerId.description: UID of the player who spawned this 3D prop.

destroyed.description: Whether the object has been destroyed/detonated.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from the parent room for secure list queries.

RoomMessage.title: RoomMessage
RoomMessage.description: Real-time multiplayer text chat message sent inside an online room lobby or match.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Display callsign of the sender (1-30 chars).

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from the parent room for secure list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest metadata sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public global leaderboard stats for an authenticated player (strictly no PII).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

bestStreak.description: Highest elimination streak in a single life (0..10000).

visibility.description: Visibility flag enabling rule-enforced global leaderboard queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest leaderboard sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DailyMission.title: DailyMission
DailyMission.description: Per-user daily mission task awarding in-game coins upon completion.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

dayKey.description: Calendar day key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

target.description: Target quantity required to complete the mission (1..10000).

rewardCoins.description: In-game coin reward granted when claimed (10..1000).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest progress or claim update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private player combat profile, coins balance, and lifetime statistics.

/users/{userId}/daily_missions/{missionI.description: Three randomized daily tasks per user per calendar day with progress and coin reward claim state.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Online multiplayer arena rooms discoverable while open.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Live 3D combat chicken state for each room member.

/rooms/{roomId}/props/{propId}.description: Synced 3D sandbox objects built by players inside the room.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time text chat messages exchanged by members in the room lobby and match.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard standings readable by authenticated players and writable only by the owner.
